column1: # ImageGen: one square word-card illustration per word.
# Warm vintage gouache on paper, earthy ochre, sage, brick red and soft teal.
# No text, words, letters, numbers, captions, signage, writing on props, logos or watermark.

column2: A handmade gingerbread cookie house with white icing, gumdrops and peppermint candy decorations on a kitchen table.
A two-part story scene: an older child looks at a framed photograph of themself as a small toddler, clearly the same person in the past, window light, the past contrasted with the present.
A smiling child with a backpack heads away along a path toward a welcoming school building, with a friend waving goodbye from a doorway.
Two children on a class trip stop to take a photo of a wide mountain view; foreground shows a child holding a simple camera and pressing the shutter.
A wide beautiful view of a lake and green mountains framed by a lookout opening, a small seated child at one edge for scale.
New Zealand nature scene: a small brown kiwi bird among native silver ferns beside a dramatic South Island fjord with lush mountains and blue water.

An aerial storybook landscape of the real Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge crossing a broad pale blue sea, long white road viaduct curving toward an artificial island, cable-stayed pylons in the distance, no flags or signs.
The Eiffel Tower clearly recognizable from its iconic iron lattice and shape, standing above a leafy Paris park at golden hour, no writing or placards.
Several life-sized ancient Chinese terracotta soldiers lined up inside a Xi'an excavation pit, their detailed clay faces and ancient armor visible, child-friendly museum illustration.

A group of schoolchildren visiting the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Museum in the green Jinggang Mountains of Jiangxi, a broad red-toned museum entrance and landscaped steps framed by lush hills. Keep the facade completely unlettered.

A classroom museum display showing a small group of Chinese Red Army soldiers from the 1930s in historically inspired gray-blue uniforms and caps with tiny red stars, trekking peacefully through green hills, red flag without lettering, no weapons foregrounded.
A child pastes a red paper heart onto a larger sheet for a craft, holding a glue stick in one hand and pressing the heart in place with the other.
A child gets dressed in the morning, visibly pulling a sleeve of a bright sweater on, with folded clothes nearby.
A lively school gala, several costumed performers on stage with curtains and warm spotlights, classmates applauding from seats, no banners or signage.
Children at an indoor celebration visually counting down with fingers raised, a big analog clock with simple tick marks and no numerals approaching midnight, sparkling decorations.
Several adults and teens running a long-distance road race through a park, road stretching far into the scene, a plain finish ribbon and spectators. Unmarked clothing and absolutely no printed bibs.
Children browsing rows of illustrated books at a bright school book fair, stands and tables filled with books bearing abstract pictorial covers only, no price tags, banners or letters.
Two connected moments: today a child by a sunny window looks back at yesterday's rainy walk, represented in a soft warm recollection vignette with the same child holding a red umbrella.

An excited child who has won a small sports trophy looks back at several less successful earlier matches shown as soft memories, conveying the best performance up to this moment, no writing or digits.
A child suffering from a common cold, bundled in a blanket, holding a tissue to a red nose at home, with tissues and a mug nearby.
A close-up of a child reaching for a tissue and holding it against a sniffly nose, gentle and dignified, with a tissue box beside them.
A child still awake reading by a small lamp late at night, night sky with a crescent moon, other household lights off, simple clock hands with ticks only.
A thoughtful child sees gathering rain clouds and hesitates over whether to take an umbrella, contrasting a patch of sun with dark clouds to convey possibility.
A child who was sick is recovering, now sitting up smiling in bed and eating fruit, with a tissue box on a bedside table and a caring parent nearby.
A child's colorful school backpack on a desk, with a pencil case and two books peeking out, distinctly a schoolbag, books have pictorial or blank covers.
A glass of orange juice, a cup of warm tea and a bottle of water arranged together on a school lunch table. The focus is on beverages, no person drinking, plain unmarked containers.
A child adds a small coin to a clear savings jar that is visibly becoming full, a picture of a desired bicycle in the background, unmarked coins and container.
A young group leader organizes a school club project, directing three classmates and laying out simple picture icons and supplies on a table, no writing.
Several different fruits are arranged together and a teacher points to one bright apple as an example, simple clearly explanatory composition.
A recognizable orbital space station with connected laboratory modules and long solar panels floats above the blue curvature of Earth, no markings, stars behind.
A child plays with a group of small round colorful glass marbles with swirling translucent centers, close-up at ground level, highly recognizable toy glass spheres.
A single monthly wall calendar with a grid of seven columns and several rows, all cells blank, beside a small seasonal plant in a room, one unlabeled page turned to show time passing.
A smiling Chinese astronaut in a white spacesuit inside a modern Chinese space station, looking toward Earth through a round window, subtle plain red patch on the suit with no text.
A child repeats a simple action in three side-by-side vignettes, bouncing the same red ball once in each vignette, teaching the idea of repeated times or occasions, no written numbers.
A child spins a small crank generator and the connected light bulb lights up, illustrative cause and effect of power, no written diagrams.
A hillside with solar panels and wind turbines visibly supplying renewable energy to a little group of homes, sunny sky, no writing.
A child switches on a flashlight, and its visible yellow beam illuminates a dark corner of a room, strong before-and-after contrast within one scene.
A parent cools a pot of hot food in a shallow basin of cool water, steam fading, with a child observing safely. Action of cooling is clear.
A washing machine is running, visible clothing spinning behind its round window, with subtle motion lines and a nearby laundry basket, control panel unmarked.
A child tips a plain milk carton into a cup and only the very last drop comes out, with an empty container and a gently surprised expression, absolutely no label.
Close-up of an adult safely unplugging a familiar electrical plug by holding its insulated body, just separated from the wall socket, with the power cord visible.
An unmarked wall-mounted split air conditioner above a window in a neat family room, subtle flowing cool air ribbons and a curtain gently moving.
A child reuses an empty glass jar by placing soil and a little seedling inside, other repurposed jars visible, no labels anywhere.
A stack of books and boxes in simple perspective, with a single bright colored object clearly at the highest position on the very top, no printed book titles.
A small boat on the Seine passes under the Pont Neuf with charming cream-colored Paris apartment rooftops and the Eiffel Tower clearly visible in the distance, golden evening, no signs.

A school student pins up an announcement on a bulletin board in the corridor while two other students turn to read it, the single new sheet contains a simple large pictogram of a school event and otherwise blank paper.
A track-meet judge in a simple striped sports shirt holds a whistle and stopwatch near the finish line, attentively judging several runners, no numerals, printed race bibs, or scoreboards.
A parent safely heats a small uncovered pot on a stovetop, warmth and light steam rise visibly, a child watches from a safe distance, no controls with digits or letters.

A friendly clearly nonhuman green extraterrestrial with rounded antennae and three eyes meets a child astronaut on a rocky moon, small flying saucer behind, unmistakable science fiction, gentle schoolbook art.
A parent gives a child a few unmarked coins from their own purse to use as spending money, close-up of open hands and happy faces, with a small coin purse waiting on the table.

An inspiring young wheelchair athlete crosses a sports finish ribbon with a broad determined smile, other children cheer and one young onlooker looks visibly motivated to try, no writing on clothing or ribbon.
An unmarked spacecraft floats in the vast dark outer space, a distant Earth and scattered stars visible, large open empty expanse emphasizing space.
A child takes on the role of a guide at a school science display, pointing out a model to two visitors with a welcoming gesture; wears a plain lanyard with an unmarked blank badge.
A child waits eagerly at an oven as golden cookies are almost ready, a simple analog timer with ticks only signals a very short remaining wait, parent nearby.

Two connected moments of one little narrative: a child puts an unfinished puzzle aside in the morning, then the same child comes back to finish it by warm evening window light, clearly the same puzzle.
